newsitem.title: USA: HealthCor names Sue Belske as CFO.
newsitem.headline: HealthCor names Sue Belske as CFO.

text.p: HealthCor said on Friday that it named Sue Belske as senior vice president and chief financial officer, a position that was vacant.

Maryelle VanAssendelft and Mary Barton have accepted promotions to senior vice president of operations for their respective territories, HealthCor said. VanAssendelft and Barton were previously vice presidents of operations.
Belske, who joined HealthCor in April of 1993 and was treasurer, has more than 14 years of experience as a chief financial officer in the home health care industry, HealthCor said.
